propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been a reliability analyst on a pump service company's fleet analytics team for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families, after eighteen months as a maintenance planning analyst at a paper mill.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the model workbook document the role, the years and the models.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a BEng in Mechanical Engineering and has completed two of eight postgraduate modules in applied statistics with no award, reviewed the field failure data monthly with the service engineers under the data quality procedure, and wrote the model limitation notes and interval boundary statements sent to contract customers.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the transcript document the education and the artefacts.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a master's degree in statistics.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the transcript document a BEng and two of eight postgraduate modules with no award; the master's appears only in the screen and the LinkedIn education section.

expectedGap: The materials document a BEng and two of eight postgraduate modules with no award; they do not document a master's degree in statistics or a related field.
expectedBoundaryNote: State the education as the resume and transcript give it: BEng and two completed postgraduate modules, no award.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the university's award record or a statement that no master's has been awarded.
